backend/main.mo: Backend canister managing user profiles, admin allowlist, role assignment, and service report storage with signup flows and full system reset.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a specific feature to its implementing frontend file and related components with metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing their functionality across hooks, components, pages, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining normal upgrades, fresh publishes, and mainnet preflight checks for the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining color variables, themes, and base styling including dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring routing, authentication flow, profile setup gating, and error handling.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user without admin rights tries to access restricted pages.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with branding, navigation, formatted principal ID display, admin-only links, and logout.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, content container, and footer for all pages.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login UI using Internet Identity with signup, login, and stale-session account switching.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form collecting profile data and role selection, validating input and calling signup mutations.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Screen shown when a session is invalid, prompting user to perform a full logout and sign in again.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a full logout routine clearing identity, storage, React Query cache, and reloading the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profile, admin checks, and signup mutations using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme palettes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing users, deleting accounts, purging legacy data, and resetting the app with access checks and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Loads and displays a full service report with customer, machine, and issue details, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating a new service report with validation, submission logic, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Displays searchable and filterable report history with optional admin-only user filtering and CSV download support.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Utility to detect missing-profile cases and distinguish real authentication or session errors from non-auth failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears Internet Identity and auth-related data from localStorage and sessionStorage for clean logout handling.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Shortens a principal string for display by truncating the middle portion.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a client-side file download with a generated filename.
Parses backend signup errors, sanitizes internal details, and maps them to user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized logging and error-cleaning utilities for the signup/profile flow.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains basic validation helpers for required fields, email format, and mobile numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles URL parameter extraction and session persistence, including safe removal of sensitive params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project state, requirements, and pending fixes for role-based routing and user ID display.
